headline: Google will make Gemini 4 Carbon available to a subset of cyber defenders
body: Google DeepMind announced Gemini 4 Carbon, which it calls its strongest model, and says it ranks #1 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at 59. Google will make Carbon available to a subset of cyber defenders starting this week, and says it is gathering feedback and iterating on guardrails before making it available to developers, businesses and consumers.
note: The first users are cyber defenders, and the benchmarks in Google's post test finding, exploitation and patching of vulnerabilities. Carbon launched two weeks after Gemini 4 Argon.

evidence.text: Today, we’re announcing the next frontier model: Gemini 4 Carbon, our strongest model with state-of-the-art cybersecurity and long horizon capabilities.
Carbon ranks #1 on the recently updated v5.0 of Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at 59.

It shows significant gains across coding and agentic tasks as well as across key capabilities critical for cybersecurity defense, landing a firm lead in SEC-bench Pro (88.2%) for finding vulnerabilities, ExploitGym (54.8%) for exploitation, and CWE-bench (71.0%) for patching.
Starting this week, we will make Carbon available to a subset of cyber defenders and will gradually phase access to additional trusted partners through our Fairwind Program .
We’re continuing to gather feedback and iterate on guardrails before making Carbon available to developers, businesses, and consumers via our product surfaces as soon as possible.

Building on Gemini 4 Argon , which was launched two weeks ago, Carbon illustrates the pace at which we’re pushing the frontier forward.
